note: The home page reads this file. To add a job, either append an object here or drop a folder at assets/recent-work/<slug>/ with before.jpg and after.jpg (png and webp work too) plus an optional job.json, then run: node scripts/index-recent-work.mjs. Leave town as an empty string until you know it. Do not invent a town, a street, or a customer name. Use only photos that are actually the before and after of the same job.
